lyrics.text: Tyle było dni do utraty sił
lyrics.translation: There were so many days to the loss of strength

lyrics.text: Do utraty tchu, tyle było chwil
lyrics.translation: To the loss of breath, there were so many moments

lyrics.text: Ważne są tylko te dni, których jeszcze nie znamy
lyrics.translation: Only those days that we do not know yet are important

lyrics.text: Ważnych jest kilka tych chwil, tych na które czekamy
lyrics.translation: Important are those few moments, the ones we are waiting for
